messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert — HIGH — Private VPC (AsteriaBank / ast-42) in us-west-2. Ingress NLB healthchecks failing for target group tg-0a1b2c; 40% 5xx observed on customer route. Paging oncall.
oncall-bot: @sara is on-call for infra/sre — acknowledged.
sara: picking this up. seeing spikes in 5xx from AsteriaBank ingress route in the dashboard. beginning triage.
mike: on network. do we have NLB healthcheck details? failing at L7 (503) or connection refused?
sara: NLB target reports 503s. backend IP 10.2.5.12 returning 503 on health endpoint. quick curl from bastion:
```
$ curl -i http://10.2.5.12:8080/health
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 14:12:01 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
Content-Length: 47

{"status":"unhealthy","error":"upstream timeout"}
```
mike: that "upstream timeout" smells like connection pooling/conntrack or a gateway NAT egress issue dropping back-conns. can someone check conntrack and TCP stats on the priv-gw?
raj: running quick checks on the gateway host now. `sudo conntrack -S` shows established ~220k (limit 262k). ephemeral port usage spiking. `ss -s` shows many TIME_WAIT/established.
kevin: if conntrack is near saturation the kernel will drop new connections which can manifest as 5xx in the app. also possible healthchecks are queued and get 503. we should: 1) temporarily increase conntrack_max, 2) add an SG rule to allow healthcheck CIDR, 3) shift traffic away from the private pool to hosted fallback while we stabilize.
liz: heads-up from CS — AsteriaBank reports intermittent payment timeouts (checkout) ~10% of users. They've asked for ETA and mitigation.
sara: agree with kevin. plan: (A) add SG rule to allow NLB healthcheck CIDR to target port 8080, (B) bump conntrack on gateway, (C) shift DNS/traffic split to 80% hosted fallback / 20% private so customer sees degraded but functional service, (D) monitor for 30m and then reassess.
mike: I'll add the SG rule now. command (AWS CLI):
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0cafe1234 --protocol tcp --port 8080 --cidr 10.0.0.0/8 --region us-west-2
```
(verify SG id before applying)
raj: increasing conntrack on gateway host now:
```
sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288
# persist: echo 'net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288' >> /etc/sysctl.d/99-conntrack.conf && sysctl --system
```
sara: I'm applying a traffic split in the console — setting AsteriaBank route to 80% hosted -> 20% private (quick rollback available). will post when complete.
amanda-cs: pinging customer: letting them know we have mitigation in progress; will update in 10 min.
mike: SG rule added (sg-0cafe1234). healthcheck source now permitted.
raj: conntrack bumped and persisted. watching metrics.
sara: traffic split applied — 80/20 hosted/private. routing change propagated; monitoring results coming in.
monitoring: metric update — AsteriaBank ingress 5xx rate decreased from 40% -> 3.8% over 4m after split + conntrack bump. latency stable.
liz: customer note: they've seen checkout failures drop significantly. they asked if we can keep hosted fallback until a root cause fix is in place.
kevin: recommend keeping traffic split until we find root cause. next steps for RCA: 1) gather conntrack/ephemeral port consumption trends, 2) audit recent kernel/iptables changes and any gateway config pushes in last 24h, 3) review app threadpool/backpressure handling that returns 503 under upstream timeout.
sara: created follow-up ticket INC-2026-1234 (triage/RCA) and assigned to eng-network + eng-runtime. marking this thread as mitigated for now. oncall will watch for 2h then hand off.
amanda-cs: passing customer update: they appreciate the quick mitigation and asked for a postmortem and ETA for full failover to a dedicated pool if this recurs.
kevin: noted — I'll draft a dedicated-pool failover runbook and a permanent remediation (conntrack tuning + keepalive and SYN backlog tuning).
sara: final status: mitigation applied (SG rule, conntrack increased, traffic split to hosted), error rate down to <1% in last 10m. leaving an oncall watch. posting post-incident blameless follow-up for RCA. :thumbsup:
amanda-cs: I'll schedule a customer call tomorrow to review.
oncall-bot: handing off oncall to @mike in 2h for watch.
incident-bot: Incident flagged for postmortem. Labels: privnet, nlb, conntrack, customer-asteria.
kevin: request: please don't revert SG/conntrack until RCA validated. we will implement safer long-term config and then revert.
sara: ack. I'll keep the thread open and update the RCA ticket with logs/graphs.
---
(End of thread)
